claims: T.J. Otzelberger is the head men's basketball coach at Iowa State University.
T.J. Otzelberger has held the position of head men's basketball coach at Iowa State University since being hired in March 2021.
As of March 2026, T.J. Otzelberger is in his 5th season as head coach at Iowa State.
T.J. Otzelberger has led Iowa State to three Sweet 16 appearances.
T.J. Otzelberger signed a contract extension in December 2024.
The contract extension keeps T.J. Otzelberger at Iowa State through the 2031-32 season.
T.J. Otzelberger previously served as head coach at UNLV.
T.J. Otzelberger previously served as head coach at South Dakota State.
T.J. Otzelberger was an assistant coach at Iowa State under Greg McDermott.
T.J. Otzelberger was an assistant coach at Iowa State under Fred Hoiberg.
T.J. Otzelberger was an assistant coach at Iowa State under Steve Prohm.
As of March 2026, T.J. Otzelberger reaffirmed his commitment to Iowa State.
